whatsNew: The Android update popup now uses a full-screen layout with much larger text and buttons for easier reading.
The What's New list is now written specifically for the release being installed instead of reusing older release notes.
The app footer now shows the current app version and follows the active release version automatically.
The Android app and website now use the same release version and build information for update prompts.
Release metadata is kept synchronized so the update dialog shows the actual changes included in the new build.
